label: Держать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for держать (to hold, to keep).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: First-person singular present. 'Держу' is the 1sg of держать; though the infinitive ends in -ать, it takes i-type endings, here -у after the hushing ж. 'Твою сумку' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Second-person singular present. 'Держишь' shows the -ишь ending of i-type держать. 'За руку' is a fixed phrase for holding someone's hand.
Strategic focus: Third-person singular present. 'Держит' is the core -ит form of держать. 'Крепко руль' shows a firm grip while driving.
Strategic focus: First-person plural present. 'Держим' carries the -им plural ending of держать, here in the sense of keeping. 'В банке' names where.
Strategic focus: Polite or plural present. 'Держите' trains the -ите form of держать. 'Дверь, пожалуйста' makes a courteous everyday request.
Strategic focus: Third-person plural present. 'Держат' closes the person ladder with the -ат ending after the hushing ж. 'Собак во дворе' means keeping animals.
Strategic focus: Past, masculine. 'Держал' is the masculine singular past of держать with the -л suffix. 'Долго зонт' sets the scene.
Strategic focus: Past, feminine. 'Держала' adds the feminine -ла ending of держать. 'Цветы в руках' completes the image.

missions.phrase: Я буду держать тебя в курсе.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Imperfective future. 'Буду' is the auxiliary and 'держать' stays in the infinitive, forming the compound future. 'В курсе' is a fixed idiom for keeping someone informed.
Strategic focus: Imperative, singular. 'Держи' is the informal command of держать. 'Крепче' and 'не урони' make an urgent instruction to one listener.
